verdict.rationale: The docs say 'you or your coding agent write the correction and choose when to activate it,' which hints that core management actions can be driven programmatically. The SDK/npm package covers only the runtime capture and prompt hooks, not a management API, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. missing for 10: a documented management API, API coverage for reviewing sessions, previewing routing against traces, holdout comparison and rollback, an explicit API-UI parity statement, and independent corroboration.
